programization_corrections: The ladder formation window begins at the prior scale-matched 4h swing that started the old leg, not at the last 4h swing broken by the reversal close.
An empty global-slot path is a valid zero-trade outcome in winner-deletion diagnostics.
A scale target consumed before decision cannot remain a target; same-bar prior target touch invalidates the action.
decision: The source-grounded ladder role conversion moved the raw surface close to break-even and retained a positive median, unlike broad first-pullback families. It nevertheless produced only 19 one-slot trades in 2022, failed 24bp and exact winner deletion, and therefore cannot support a steady-compounding Core. Retire without pivot, rung-count, body, scale, target/stop, session, SMC-gate, asset-side, cost, ML, risk or leverage rescue.
